description.value: Wake Up Jake Restaurant is an independent seasonal eatery operating inside Barkerville Historic Town & Park, the largest living history museum in western North America and a National Historic Site of Canada. Housed in Building #56 in the heart of this authentically restored gold-rush townsite, it serves a full menu of old-style favourites spanning breakfast, lunch, and supper, including children's specials. Touring cyclists riding the Cariboo region will find it one of the most historically atmospheric full-service meal stops in BC.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The Barkerville merchants page confirms Wake Up Jake Restaurant is an active independent operator at Building #56 within Barkerville Historic Town & Park, serving breakfast, lunch, and supper with children's specials during the 2026 main season. No cyclist-specific amenities (bike parking, water refill, washrooms, Wi-Fi, etc.) are mentioned anywhere in the website content. The general Barkerville address and phone from the contact page belong to the heritage site as a whole, not specifically to Wake Up Jake; OSM carries no contact details of its own to cross-check.
concerns: No dedicated website for Wake Up Jake Restaurant; the URL resolves to the Barkerville merchants listing page covering multiple businesses.
No restaurant-specific phone number is published; the (888) 994-3332 number on the contact page is the general Barkerville Heritage Trust line.
Address used is the general Barkerville mailing address (Box 19, 14301 Highway 26 East); the restaurant itself is Building #56 within the pedestrian historic townsite.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A real, confirmed, publicly accessible restaurant operating inside a major BC heritage attraction; clearly useful to touring cyclists in the Cariboo region.
enrichment_extras.notes: Restaurant operates as an independent licensee within Barkerville Historic Town & Park. Visitors must enter the heritage site (admission required during main season) to access the restaurant.
